open_todos.content: R1: Audit oiioii.ai UI map (landing, /features/canvas, /features/image-generation, pricing) and diff against existing oioi scaffold — log missing routes/components/data sources

R2: Expand provider registry to 25+ real free-tier models (Pollinations flux/flux-realism/flux-anime/turbo, Gemini free, Groq llama-3.1-70b/mixtral, OpenRouter free, Cerebras, Cohere, Cloudflare Workers AI) with id/provider/category/capabilities/health_url

R3: Expand styles registry to 150+ named styles with structured prompt templates (positive/negative/recommended_models/example_seed/preview_path) across Anime/3D/Illustrated/Pixel/Painting/Photographic/Cyberpunk/Minimalist categories

R4: Implement 7-agent animation pipeline end-to-end with typed contracts (Scriptwriter→Art Director→Character Designer→Scene Designer→Storyboard Artist→Animator→Sound Director→Director) including Smart mode deterministic flow and Chat mode streaming/approval state machine

R5: Build Expo/React Native infinite AI Animation Canvas UI — pan/zoom Skia canvas, dual-mode Smart/Chat shell with SSE, Style Library (150+), Model Selector (25+), My Assets, Bento credit indicator, dark neon studio visual language

R6: Implement expo-node backend — hono REST routes (/v1/projects,assets,jobs,styles,models,chat/stream,generate), Drizzle+SQLite persistence, better-queue job queue, JWT auth, SSE chat streaming agent status

R7: Write TDD test suite — one integration test per agent hitting real free provider, provider health/failover tests, contract tests per agent_contract, E2E test for canonical 'shy cat superhero rainy Tokyo' Smart+Ghibli prompt asserting final video URI

acceptance_criteria: A user logs in (or is auto-provisioned a mock JWT) and sees the landing page with “Good morning, director!” greeting, quick-create cards, and their projects list — pixel-conformant to oiioii.ai within 8px of reference layout on a 1440-wide viewport.

Selecting a quick-create card and entering a story idea in Smart mode + choosing a style triggers the Scriptwriter agent to call a real LLM (Groq or OpenRouter) and return a structured JSON scene list, visible in the UI within 10s.
The Art Director agent receives the script and emits a shot list with framing + style directives before any image generation begins.

The Character Designer agent produces at least one real generated character reference image (via Pollinations flux or equivalent) and the image is visible in My Assets under a persistent `character_id` with a face-lock badge.
The Scene Designer agent produces at least one real generated environment image per scene, visible in My Assets and inline in the Canvas.
The Storyboard Artist agent generates N real storyboard frames (where N ≥ scenes × shots_per_scene, default 2 shots/scene) visible as editable clips on the infinite canvas.
The Animator agent produces a real video clip (5+ seconds, MP4 or WebM) OR a stitched frame sequence for each shot, downloadable from the UI.
The Sound Director agent attaches audio (generated or retrieved) to at least 60% of scene frames, with segments aligned to scene durations.
The Director agent assembles the final video with audio via ffmpeg, produces a single `final_video_uri`, and the project status flips to `complete`. The video is playable in-app and downloadable.

Chat mode allows the user to open the right panel, select any agent, send a text instruction, and receive a streamed LLM response that updates the agent's output with the ability to approve/reject/re-roll.

Style Library is populated with 150+ named styles, each with a working preview image and a structured prompt template that is actually applied during generation (visible in the expanded "Prompt" drawer on a frame).

Model Selector dropdown lists 25+ models grouped by category, each with correct capability tokens, enabled flag driven by live provider health checks, and selecting a model changes downstream generation calls.
My Assets screen shows all created characters, scenes, styles, and scripts for the current project with version history and re-use buttons.
Projects persist across sessions: create a project, log out, log in, and the project reappears with all assets and storyboard frames intact.

Provider Registry has built-in failover: disable Pollinations mid-run by editing the DB or sending a fail signal; the next image generation retry routes to an alternate provider without crashing the pipeline.
Job Queue shows live progress per job in the UI: queued → working → complete, with elapsed time and retry count.
Auth is enforced: all `/v1/*` routes reject requests without a valid JWT with 401.
Test suite includes at least one integration test per agent that makes a real provider call and asserts a non-empty, schema-valid artifact. Tests must not rely on hardcoded strings.

A real end-to-end test (Playwright or Detox) submits the canonical prompt "a shy cat becomes a superhero in rainy Tokyo" in Smart mode + Ghibli style, waits up to 5 minutes, and asserts: project status `complete`, at least one character image exists, final video URI is present, and video duration ≥ 5 seconds.

`.neon_project_state.json` updated to `verified: true` with timestamp; VERIFICATION.md contains a test-run log showing real artifact URIs and model IDs; CONSUMER_COMPENSATION.md present and lists all approximation gaps with future premium paths.
